acceptanceCriteria.surface: The merged README.md on the main branch of sjawhar/legion-smoke, viewed on GitHub.

integration: Single-file append on the legion/S390409560-1 bookmark; PR body must carry 'Dispatch: S390409560-1'. No stacking, no migrations.
ordering: T1 (implement + push + open PR) -> T2 (test verifies the appended line and single-file scope) -> T3 (review; optional in-scope one-more-line follow-on) -> merge.

implement: none: reviewed the system-prompt <skills> list and repo root; only legion-* workflow and dispatch/envoy skills exist, none governs appending a line to README.md in this sandbox — it is a plain single-file edit.
review: none: no repository review skill applies; standard Legion review discipline (single-file scope, in-scope one-more-line follow-on) governs, driven by the reviewer charter.
test: none: no repository test/smoke skill exists for legion-smoke; verification is reading README.md on the branch head and confirming exactly one appended line with no other file changed.

risks: Multiple pre-existing Stage 3 proof lines already exist in README.md; the implementer must append exactly the specified line once and change no other file.
The in-scope follow-on line must go to README.md only; a request touching any other file is out of scope.
summary: One-file smoke change: append exactly one line to README.md at the root of sjawhar/legion-smoke reading 'Stage 3 workflow proof: design gate exercised.' A review may request one additional appended line to the same README.md, which is in scope for this same issue and PR.

tasks.description: Append exactly one line 'Stage 3 workflow proof: design gate exercised.' to the end of README.md. If README.md is absent, create it containing that single line.
Verify the appended line is present in README.md on the pushed branch head; prove on the real file (read README.md and the PR diff). Negative control: confirm no other file changed.
Review the PR diff; it may request one more appended line to the same README.md (in scope). Any change to a file other than README.md is out of scope and raised as a separate issue.
